text: Tik om Fuel Smoothing te starten

key: Battery/background start was denied. Open once so the plugin can run with Torque.
source: Battery/background start was denied. Open once so the plugin can run with Torque.
text: Start via batterij/achtergrond is geweigerd. Open eenmaal zodat de plugin met Torque kan draaien.

key: Add additional tanks as needed (stock tank 1 always stays). Do not switch senders onto the PCM FLI pin (false fill). Each extra tank needs its own Torque extra PID (MCU Mode 22, unique name — not 012F or Ford 16C1). Select-PID value is the 1-based tank id. Gal/hr is charged only to the active tank.
source: Add additional tanks as needed (stock tank 1 always stays). Do not switch senders onto the PCM FLI pin (false fill). Each extra tank needs its own Torque extra PID (MCU Mode 22, unique name — not 012F or Ford 16C1). Select-PID value is the 1-based tank id. Gal/hr is charged only to the active tank.
text: Voeg zo nodig extra tanks toe (standaardtank 1 blijft altijd). Zet sensoren niet op de PCM FLI-pen (valse tankbeurt). Elke extra tank heeft een eigen extra Torque-PID nodig (MCU Mode 22, unieke naam — niet 012F of Ford 16C1). De Select-PID-waarde is het tanknummer vanaf 1. Gal/hr wordt alleen aan de actieve tank toegerekend.

key: Writes a value onto Torque's stock Fuel Level (012F) so existing gauges show it: Off, Smoothed, or Corrected from the Chunk, Band or Kalman fit. A fit that is not built yet writes the smoothed level.
source: Writes a value onto Torque's stock Fuel Level (012F) so existing gauges show it: Off, Smoothed, or Corrected from the Chunk, Band or Kalman fit. A fit that is not built yet writes the smoothed level.
text: Schrijft een waarde naar de standaard Fuel Level (012F) van Torque zodat bestaande meters die tonen: Uit, Vloeiend of Gecorrigeerd vanuit de Chunk-, Band- of Kalman-fit. Een fit die nog niet is opgebouwd schrijft het vloeiende niveau.

key: Requires Torque Pro (paid). Torque Lite does not support plugins.
source: Requires Torque Pro (paid). Torque Lite does not support plugins.
text: Vereist Torque Pro (betaald). Torque Lite ondersteunt geen plugins.

key: The name of this vehicle profile. Each Torque vehicle profile gets its own plugin profile, data and learned maps.
source: The name of this vehicle profile. Each Torque vehicle profile gets its own plugin profile, data and learned maps.
text: De naam van dit voertuigprofiel. Elk Torque-voertuigprofiel krijgt een eigen pluginprofiel, gegevens en geleerde kaarten.

key: Vehicle make (e.g. Ford). Used only to choose which brand-specific fuel PIDs detection may try.
source: Vehicle make (e.g. Ford). Used only to choose which brand-specific fuel PIDs detection may try.
text: Voertuigmerk (bijv. Ford). Alleen gebruikt om te kiezen welke merkgebonden brandstof-PID's de detectie mag proberen.

key: Where the raw fuel level comes from. Detect (needs the ECU connected) tries the candidates read-only and asks you to confirm unless two sources agree. Confirm is on the setup page and in the notification. None = detect on the next connect.
source: Where the raw fuel level comes from. Detect (needs the ECU connected) tries the candidates read-only and asks you to confirm unless two sources agree. Confirm is on the setup page and in the notification. None = detect on the next connect.
text: Waar het ruwe brandstofniveau vandaan komt. Detecteren (de ECU moet verbonden zijn) probeert de kandidaten alleen-lezen en vraagt te bevestigen, tenzij twee bronnen overeenkomen. Bevestigen staat op de instelpagina en in de melding. Geen = detecteren bij de volgende verbinding.

key: Only for the source "Torque extra PID by long name": the exact long name of the Torque PID that reports the level.
source: Only for the source "Torque extra PID by long name": the exact long name of the Torque PID that reports the level.
text: Alleen voor de bron „Extra Torque-PID op lange naam”: de exacte lange naam van de Torque-PID die het niveau meldt.

key: Time constant of the smoothing filter (0 = no smoothing).
source: Time constant of the smoothing filter (0 = no smoothing).
text: Tijdconstante van het vloeiendheidsfilter (0 = niet vloeiend maken).

key: Largest change per second the smoothed level may follow; slosh beyond this is ignored.
source: Largest change per second the smoothed level may follow; slosh beyond this is ignored.
text: Grootste verandering per seconde die het vloeiende niveau mag volgen; geklots daarboven wordt genegeerd.

key: Optional: enter the odometer reading and Save pin to anchor distance for this profile.
source: Optional: enter the odometer reading and Save pin to anchor distance for this profile.
text: Optioneel: voer de tellerstand in en sla de pin op om de afstand voor dit profiel te verankeren.

key: Which tank the fuel burn (gal/hr) is charged to. From PID: a Torque PID chooses it (1-based tank id).
source: Which tank the fuel burn (gal/hr) is charged to. From PID: a Torque PID chooses it (1-based tank id).
text: Aan welke tank het verbruik (gal/hr) wordt toegerekend. Van PID: een Torque-PID kiest die (tanknummer vanaf 1).

key: Only when Active tank = From PID: the long name of the Torque PID whose value is the tank id.
source: Only when Active tank = From PID: the long name of the Torque PID whose value is the tank id.
text: Alleen als Actieve tank = Van PID: de lange naam van de Torque-PID waarvan de waarde het tanknummer is.

key:
Quick start
 1. Install Torque Pro (the paid version; Torque Lite does not support plugins) and pair your OBD-II adapter.
 2. Enable this plugin in Torque → Settings → Plugins.
 3. Allow notifications, and set battery use to Unrestricted so Torque can start this plugin in the background.
 4. In Torque, select the vehicle profile for the car you are driving. Data is kept per Torque profile and checked against the vehicle's VIN/ECU identity.
 5. On a new profile the fuel source is detected when you connect; if asked, compare it with your dash gauge and tap Confirm. Confirm is on the setup page and in the notification. You can also pick it below.
 6. There is no tank size to enter here. Each fit learns its own size, shown under Learned tank size; until then its corrected percent reads 1:1 with the gauge. Enter your tank size in the Torque vehicle profile for Torque's own remaining fuel and DTE.
 7. In Torque, add gauges for [FuelSmooth] Smoothed Fuel Level and each fit's Corrected % and Tank size. The plugin does not publish remaining fuel or DTE. A notice during a refit says that fit reads 1:1 until its refit finishes.
 8. Feed fuel level back to Torque: Off, Smoothed, or Corrected from the Chunk, Band or Kalman fit onto your 012F gauge. Torque's own fuel remaining and DTE then use that level with the tank size and long-term mpg in the Torque profile.
 9. Fuel is counted only while the engine runs. The plugin runs only while Torque is connected to the ECU.
 10. Keep driving and filling up; accuracy builds over several partial tanks. If the plugin cannot tell which vehicle this is, it asks in a notification and on this page; choose what to do with that drive.
 11. All data stays on this phone. No GPS or location is recorded.

Quick start
 1. Install Torque Pro (the paid version; Torque Lite does not support plugins) and pair your OBD-II adapter.
 2. Enable this plugin in Torque → Settings → Plugins.
 3. Allow notifications, and set battery use to Unrestricted so Torque can start this plugin in the background.
 4. In Torque, select the vehicle profile for the car you are driving. Data is kept per Torque profile and checked against the vehicle's VIN/ECU identity.
 5. On a new profile the fuel source is detected when you connect; if asked, compare it with your dash gauge and tap Confirm. Confirm is on the setup page and in the notification. You can also pick it below.
 6. There is no tank size to enter here. Each fit learns its own size, shown under Learned tank size; until then its corrected percent reads 1:1 with the gauge. Enter your tank size in the Torque vehicle profile for Torque's own remaining fuel and DTE.
 7. In Torque, add gauges for [FuelSmooth] Smoothed Fuel Level and each fit's Corrected % and Tank size. The plugin does not publish remaining fuel or DTE. A notice during a refit says that fit reads 1:1 until its refit finishes.
 8. Feed fuel level back to Torque: Off, Smoothed, or Corrected from the Chunk, Band or Kalman fit onto your 012F gauge. Torque's own fuel remaining and DTE then use that level with the tank size and long-term mpg in the Torque profile.
 9. Fuel is counted only while the engine runs. The plugin runs only while Torque is connected to the ECU.
 10. Keep driving and filling up; accuracy builds over several partial tanks. If the plugin cannot tell which vehicle this is, it asks in a notification and on this page; choose what to do with that drive.
 11. All data stays on this phone. No GPS or location is recorded.
text:
Snel starten

Installeer Torque Pro (de betaalde versie; Torque Lite ondersteunt geen plugins) en koppel uw OBD-II-adapter.

Schakel deze plugin in bij Torque → Instellingen → Plugins.

Sta meldingen toe en zet batterijgebruik op Onbeperkt, zodat Torque deze plugin op de achtergrond kan starten.

Kies in Torque het voertuigprofiel van de auto waarin u rijdt. Gegevens blijven per Torque-profiel en worden gecontroleerd aan de VIN/ECU-identiteit van het voertuig.

Bij een nieuw profiel wordt de brandstofbron gedetecteerd bij het verbinden; als dat wordt gevraagd, vergelijk die met de meter op het dashboard en tik op Bevestigen. Bevestigen staat op de instelpagina en in de melding. U kunt die ook hieronder kiezen.

Hier is geen tankinhoud in te voeren. Elke fit leert zijn eigen grootte, getoond onder Geleerde tankinhoud; tot dan leest het gecorrigeerde percentage 1:1 met de meter. Voer de tankinhoud in het Torque-voertuigprofiel in voor de eigen resterende brandstof en DTE van Torque.

Voeg in Torque meters toe voor [FuelSmooth] Smoothed Fuel Level en, per fit, Corrected % en Tank size. De plugin publiceert geen resterende brandstof of DTE. Een melding tijdens een herberekening zegt dat die fit 1:1 leest tot de herberekening klaar is.

Brandstofniveau terug naar Torque sturen: Uit, Vloeiend of Gecorrigeerd vanuit de Chunk-, Band- of Kalman-fit, naar uw 012F-meter. De eigen resterende brandstof en DTE van Torque gebruiken dat niveau daarna met de tankinhoud en de mpg op lange termijn in het Torque-profiel.

Brandstof telt alleen terwijl de motor draait. De plugin draait alleen terwijl Torque met de ECU is verbonden.

Blijf rijden en tanken; de nauwkeurigheid groeit over meerdere deeltanks. Als de plugin niet kan zeggen welk voertuig dit is, vraagt die dat in een melding en op deze pagina; kies wat er met die rit gebeurt.

Alle gegevens blijven op deze telefoon. Er wordt geen GPS of locatie vastgelegd.

key: Each fit's own learned size, reported by the plugin; there is nothing to enter. Torque's own fuel remaining and DTE use the tank size in the Torque vehicle profile.
source: Each fit's own learned size, reported by the plugin; there is nothing to enter. Torque's own fuel remaining and DTE use the tank size in the Torque vehicle profile.
text: De eigen geleerde grootte van elke fit, zoals de plugin die meldt; er is niets in te voeren. De eigen resterende brandstof en DTE van Torque gebruiken de tankinhoud in het Torque-voertuigprofiel.

source: This drive will be saved to %1$s.

source: This vehicle sent no VIN and more than one saved profile could match.

source: Its fuel level (%1$.0f %%) is higher than %2$s's last recorded level (%3$.0f %%). Was it filled?
text: Het brandstofniveau (%1$.0f %%) is hoger dan het laatst vastgelegde niveau van %2$s (%3$.0f %%). Is er getankt?

key: Its fuel level (%1$.0f %%) does not match %2$s's last recorded level (%3$.0f %%).
source: Its fuel level (%1$.0f %%) does not match %2$s's last recorded level (%3$.0f %%).

source: Its fuel level could not be read to compare with %1$s.

key: Asks which vehicle is connected when it cannot be matched automatically.
source: Asks which vehicle is connected when it cannot be matched automatically.
text: Vraagt welk voertuig is verbonden wanneer het niet automatisch kan worden gekoppeld.
